profile.headline: Professional with experience in several fields, seeking a career in full stack web development with the right company!

positions.title: Systems ISV Marketing Lead
positions.description:
•	Leverage knowledge of STG portfolio market management to initiate and complete process for marketing deliverables across STG Brands, Ecosystem Development (EcoD), and technical teams.  
•	Act as a liaison between the various stakeholders in the ISV ecosystem space in order to facilitate the on-time availability of ISV-centric deliverables.
•	Work across the IBM organizational matrix to effectively deliver collateral, events, messaging, market communications across the multiple ISVs that STG identifies as needing marketing support.  
•	Drive channel enablement across STG marketing solution initiatives including Cloud, Analytics, Mobile, Social, and Security.
•	Leverage ISV solution growth launch and other go-to-market tactics.
•	Translate plans into actions which drive Top ISV solution marketing and solution revenue results.
•	Manage the 3rd parties and external agencies to provide market development support for selected STG ISVs.

positions.title: Business Ops Financial Management
positions.description:
Maintain current status of program & infrastructure expenses for all Alliance Partner and Overall Top Level budgets.  Partners include IBM’s top 9 Global Alliances such as SAP, Oracle, Infor, Cisco, Lenovo, Genesys, Juniper and Microsoft.
•	Planning and forecasting the $17 million annual budget for Global Alliances Marketing.
•	Interact with Marketing & Channel Enablement Executives and Managers to forecast and plan for budget overages/under runs to ensure targets are achieved.
•	Create & maintain documentation for all spend under the Vice President of Global Alliances/ISV Marketing.
•	Develop presentations and other reporting documentation to detail current status of budgets & spending forecasts and review with VP & Director level executives.
•	Document exception process for alliance partner co-marketing & reimbursement guidelines.
•	Train team on IBM Sales & Distribution expense processes and tools.

positions.title: Global Network Product Support Engineer
positions.description:
Team-oriented environment of 51 engineers for Tier-2 support role of High Capacity Optical Network products. Involved investigation of product issues for global customers.
•	Supported and troubleshot UNIX-based management platforms, network connectivity issues, and the Nortel Hi-Cap Optical portfolio products (SONET/SDH).
•	Participated with design community, support teams, and customers to identify improvements in supportability and reliability as well as feature content of emerging products and software.
•	Provided training to both internal and external customers using formal presentations and lab demonstrations.
•	Reproduced customer issues in lab situations to rectify the problem and created instructions on resolving the issue.
•	Developed detailed root cause analysis documentation to provide customers with recommendations on how to resolve/prevent future network failure.
•	Assisted design community with the testing of emerging products to ensure a high standard of quality for our customers.
•	Maintained internal group web page using HTML, Java, and SQL on a UNIX platform.

positions.title: Integration Consultant / Application Programmer
positions.description:
Team/Individual-oriented environment of 8 consultants.  Developed custom real-time and batch applications for hand-held devices.  Performed all aspects of the SDLC.
•	Utilized languages such as JavaScript, C++ and Visual Basic to develop client/server applications for platforms such as DOS, Palm, and Windows 9x/2000/NT.
•	Worked with databases such as Oracle, Access, SQL Server and Peoplesoft (Vantive) to house application data using API calls, SQL, and ODBC.
•	Produced customer-specific design documents detailing application requirements, limitations, program flow, GUI layouts, label/report layouts, and test plans.
•	Provided sales and user support by performing demos, presenting technology overviews, and training sessions.
•	Completed test plans to ensure application stability and reliability.  Included unit, functional, integration, stress, and regression testing procedures.
•	Supported customers after implementation of programs with any software and/or hardware issues and version upgrades.

educations.schoolName: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

projects.title: Data Night Front-End Web App
projects.description:
Dinner and a movie planning web application.  The app allows the user to enter a location, style of food and movie.  The application then gives the user 3 locally based choices to select from based off their moive and food style selections.  Once the user makes their final choice the app will give the user the full details for each selection to be able to enjoy a nice date or a friend / family night out! 
Technologies used - Bulma, AJAX, JSON, APIs, jQuery, JavaScript
